bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks and excessively large bags cannot be brought in. Bags are inspected at entry; the FAQ does not give a numeric size limit.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Only street parking is available; Neumos has no official parking partners.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Neumos. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Outside food and drinks are not permitted at a show.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: For an accessible seat, purchase a ticket and submit the venue’s request form at least 36 hours in advance on weekdays. Limited regular mezzanine seating is first come first served.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Neumos FAQ does not publish a re-entry rule.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Ticket delivery options include AXS Mobile ID, will call and mail. Paper tickets may be bought in person through the venue’s Runaway box office during its operating hours.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Entry includes a metal detector and thorough bag check. Door times are set per event.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
